issues.description: Field de.tum.cit.ase.Animal.name: The problem statement / UML (problem_statement.md) declares an attribute 'name' of type String, while the solution implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java) declares the field as private StringBuilder name. This is an attribute type mismatch that can confuse students who expect the attribute to be a String and expect constructor/getter/setter to use String directly.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution match the UML/specification by changing the Animal class field to 'private String name' and updating the constructor, getName() and setName(...) to use String. Alternatively, if a mutable StringBuilder is intentionally required, update the problem statement/UML to indicate that the internal representation may be a StringBuilder; the preferred fix is to use String in the solution to match the UML and avoid student confusion.
